sn54.5:1.1: bhikkhave bhā- bahu- mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā ||
sn54.5:1.2: katham bhāvitā ca bhikkhave katham bahumahapphalā hoti mahanisaṃsā || || 4--10.
sn54.5:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati- vitthāro ||
sn54.5:1.6: Evam bhāvitā kho bhikkhave ānāpānasati evambahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || 12.
sn54.5:2.1: Evam bhāvitāya kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatiyā evam bahulīkatāya satta phalā sattānisaṃsā paṭikaṅkhā ||
sn54.5:2.4: No ce diṭṭheva dhamme paṭihacca aññam ārādheti ||
sn54.5:2.6: aññam ārādheti || || No ce maraṇakāle aññam ārādheti ||
sn54.5:2.7: atha pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānam parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti ||
sn54.5:2.12: Evam bhāvitāya kho bhikkhave ānāpānasatiyā evam bahulīkatāya ime satta phalā sattānisaṃsā paṭikaṅkhā ti || || 1--2.
